# INSIGHTS — summarized, verified findings (accumulate across the whole run)

The JOURNAL is your per-iteration diary; THIS file is the distilled, VERIFIED takeaway a future iteration should read instead of re-reading the whole journal or old sessions/traces. Update it whenever you have a genuinely NEW, confirmed finding (an accepted/rejected RESULT counts as confirmation; a guess does not) — not every iteration needs a new entry. Structure each addition as:

    ## <task or mechanism name>
    - What worked (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - What didn't (confirmed by a RESULT, cite the candidate id):
    - Promising but not yet tried:

- (cand_0001, unverified until RESULT) Gold facts from DB: task 23 gold cancels a basic-economy reservation booked <24h ago; task 44 gold upgrades basic-economy reservations keeping flights, including one with 7h door-to-door (so "≤3h" was judged per flight). Any cancel/update guard must allow these.

- (cand_0002, unverified until RESULT) Task 10 true prices: moving 4NQLHD outbound to May 24 in business costs $1302 (HAT131) / $2010 (HAT190) for 3 pax — both over the user's $1000, so gold is no write; agent quotes $495/$670 by forgetting ×passengers / all-flights cabin. Gold 23 = cancel + 3 single-passenger bookings (one certificate each).

- (cand_0003, unverified until RESULT) DB facts: price-sorted seat-filtered search reproduces gold choices for 20 (HAT136+HAT039), 23 (HAT023 / HAT204+HAT100) and 35 ("second cheapest" = HAT069+HAT258, rank 2 incl. the direct flight). EWR→SEA $255 options have 0 economy seats — always seat-filter. Confirmed run-wide: cand_0001 and cand_0002 guards ACCEPTED with broke={}.
